# PR #4948: Patch: the AI's redaction numbers new ids from what its seat can see, so ids minted where it cannot see no longer change its decision

Closes #4824

## What changed

`redact` (`crates/ai/src/observe.rs`) used to keep the true state's id counter. That counter goes up when ids are made where the seat cannot see, for example the two Fruits S+ #17 Smoothie gets when its owner draws it. A new last step now sets the counter one past the highest id the redaction still contains:
- an instance (`c<n>`), a prompt (`q<n>`) or a secret choice (`secret-<n>`), read anywhere in the redaction's JSON, keys included;
- an Echo's waiting repeat (`e<n>`), read from `echo_queue` only.

So two states the seat's view cannot tell apart now give one redaction and one `Decision` (R185).

- **New ruling R4824000.** Note in `spec/rulings/R4824000.md`, its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/4824.md`. R185's note now names the id counter among what is redacted, and `crates/ai/README.md`'s list of what `redact` blanks says the same.
- **`mutate_hidden`** (`crates/ai/tests/ai/observe.rs`) now raises `next_id` by 1–10. The existing b9 redaction property, the b11 decide property and the lethal-hint property therefore also cover the counter.
- **`crates/ai/tests/ai/redact_unseen_ids.rs`** holds four `r4824000_` tests, built from the issue's `audit_fuzz.rs`:
  - the redactions of the two Smoothie worlds are equal at every JSON path;
  - their decisions are equal (action, stats, rng cursor) at `AI_BUDGET`;
  - on every 6th decision of a seeded Hard-vs-Easy match, the whole `Decision` is unchanged with `next_id + 2`;
  - on random-policy games, from both seats, the redaction's counter is no higher than the true one, is one past an id the redaction contains, and no id the redaction contains falls between it and the true counter.

No patch fragment: only the AI changes, and no card plays differently.

## How it was tested

- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai redact_unseen_ids`: 4 passed.
- **Mutation check.** With the Step 8 line replaced by `let _ = first_unnamed_id;`, `cargo test -p jackioh-ai --test ai -- redact_unseen_ids observe::` gave `41 passed; 6 failed`. The six were the four `r4824000_` tests, `r185_b9_property_any_mutation_…` and `r185_b11_decide_gives_deep_equal_decisions_for_random_mutations_of_real_states`. The line was restored afterwards.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-ai`: 69 unit tests, 1079 in `ai` and 104 in `ai_slow` passed; 15 ignored (the existing daily tests).
- `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`: exit 0, 24,004 passed, 0 failed, 49 ignored. `git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire` was empty afterwards.
- `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`: both clean.
- `cargo jackioh spec check`: `2599 rulings, 6420 proofs, 78469 citations in 5030 files, 35488 links: ok`.
- `jackioh catalog check` and `jackioh patches check`: both ok.
- Not run: the web tests (no web file changed, so `--changed origin/main` has nothing to pick up). I also ran `jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`, but it printed `classify: Internal` only because nothing is committed yet; it said nothing about this change. CI's `rust (classify)` will run it properly.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- **The counter is found by walking the redaction's whole JSON, not by walking piles and prompts by type.** A typed walk would miss ids kept in resume data, card memory, events and map keys, and a lower counter could then hand out one of those ids again.
- **Echo ids are read from the Echo queue only; `e` is not a prefix searched everywhere.** The trigger dispatch numbers its own `e<n>` ids from `next_seq` (`crates/engine/src/triggers.rs`). Searching `e` everywhere would read those and could push the counter above the true one.
- **The counter is set last, on the finished redaction.** Redacting twice (as the arena and the worker do) then leaves it unchanged; `redact_twice` passes.
- **The issue's third test is replaced** by a comparison of the whole `Decision` on every 6th decision of the same match. It checked only the action at decision 61, and the plan found that check passes without the fix on current `main`.
- **The two kept tests' doc comments now use the past tense** ("Keeping the true counter, it gave `nextId` 54 and 56", "the search walked 424 nodes…"), since those numbers describe the behaviour before the fix. Their bodies are as the issue wrote them.
- **Left out of scope:** `next_seq`, which `redact` also keeps (the audit did not show it leaking), and the engine-side gap in later public ids after an unseen Smoothie draw, which the issue leaves to the owner of the view.

## Worth a second look

- **Ids the search makes never reach the game.** `submitted` (#1575) tries only `decision.action` on the true state. That is the first action of the line, so it names ids the real state already holds; ids made on the redacted copy appear only in `line[1..]`.
- **`crates/ai/src/duos.rs:580`, unchanged.** It numbers a passed card `c{next_id}` on `determinize(redact(…))`. `determinize` makes no new ids, so that id is free in the copy.
- **The AI will play differently.** In most mid-game states the new counter is below the true one, so the ids the search gives its simulated prompts, the sample of answers it draws and the order it sorts them in all shift. No per-PR test is pinned to an exact AI choice that this changed (the workspace suite is green), but the daily AI gates (`cargo jackioh gate --full`) will play differently.
- **Cost.** One `serde_json::to_value` of the state per `redact` call. `redact` runs a few times per decision, not once per search node.
